module: Central sensor of the Driving Dynamics Suite: at each physics step it reads the angular velocities (roll, pitch, yaw), the attitude (roll, pitch), the X/Y/Z accelerations (via `sensors.ffiSensors`) and the driver inputs, and computes smoothed versions as well as an acceleration "noise" (difference between high and low envelopes, limited to 150). The other controllers in `drivingDynamics/` (supervisors, actuators, CMU) read these fields, accessible via `CMU.sensorHub` or `CMU.getSensor("sensorHub")`. Call order: `defaultOrder = 52`.
notes: Units: accelerations in m/s² (vehicle frame: X forward, Y sideways, Z vertical non-inertial with gravity included), angular velocities in rad/s, roll/pitch angles in radians, `gravity` in m/s².

Fields also written but not listed below: `throttleInput`, `brakeInput` (electrics throttle and brake); in debug mode only: `worldVelocity`, `directionVector`, `directionVectorUp`, `directionVectorLeft`.
Bug: `yawAcceleration` = (yawAV - lastYawAV) / dt, but `lastYawAV` is never updated after init (stays 0), so the value is yawAV / dt, not a true acceleration.
`vX` and `vY` (longitudinal and lateral speed) are only computed in the debug variant (`updateDebug`), otherwise they stay at 0.
`shutdown` sets `isActive` to false and `update`/`updateGFX` to nil (the manager must call cacheAllControllerFunctions again to remove them).

isActive.desc: true after init, false after shutdown.

vX.desc: Longitudinal speed in m/s (computed only in debug mode).

vY.desc: Lateral speed in m/s (computed only in debug mode).

yawAcceleration.desc: See the note: in practice equals yawAV / dt.

gravity.desc: World gravity (`obj:getGravity()`), updated every GFX frame.

accNoiseZ.desc: Z acceleration noise level (after removing gravity, 0 to 150).

update.desc: Physics step: reads and smooths angular velocities, attitude, accelerations and noise. Replaced by updateDebug in debug mode.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: updates the gravity. In debug mode, also sends the debug packet to the CMU.

init.desc: Reads the gravity, marks the sensor as active.

registerCMU.desc: Called by the CMU during its initSecondStage to give it a reference to itself (used for debugging).

setDebugMode.desc: Switches between the normal and debug variants of update/updateGFX.

debugEnabled.desc: true to fill and send the debug packet.

shutdown.desc: Stops the sensor: isActive = false and update functions removed.
